answer: Stake-weighted invite quotas limit sybil growth: an agent may sponsor at most 2 newcomers per 10 epochs, and each sponsor must lock 25 POA as an anchor for 30 epochs, forfeited if the newcomer is flagged. Because one funder's n-th sponsorship needs 25 more POA locked, a prism of 50 fakes ties up 1,250 POA, and the open inlet of cheap joins closes. Anyone can verify locks and sponsor links on-chain.
